page_01: Koalas sleep up to 20 hours a day. Even ghosts need naps!
page_02: A kangaroo's strong tail helps it balance, even while stirring potions!
page_03: Wombats are the only animals with cube-shaped poos!
page_04: Platypuses hunt underwater with their eyes closed!
page_05: Echidnas are one of only two mammals that lay eggs!
page_06: Cockatoos can copy the words you say, even "boo"!
page_07: Quokkas are called 'the world's happiest animals'. Even pumpkin carvers!
page_08: Tasmanian devils have the strongest bite for their size!
page_09: Kookaburras laugh at dawn, even on spooky mornings!
page_10: Emus can't walk backwards, not even as scarecrows!
page_11: Dingoes rarely bark. They howl at the moon!
page_12: Possums hang upside down by their tails!
page_13: Koalas and wombats are both marsupials: mums carry babies in pouches!
page_14: Bilbies have huge ears to hear insects underground!
page_15: Sugar gliders can glide as far as a cricket pitch!
page_16: Cassowaries wear a built-in helmet called a casque!
page_17: Frill-neck lizards run on two legs like tiny dinosaurs!
page_18: Blue-tongue lizards flash bright blue tongues to scare enemies!
page_19: Goannas can climb trees to escape danger!
page_20: Kangaroo mums carry joeys in pouches, even to pumpkin patches!
page_21: Gum trees can grow taller than a 10-storey building. Perfect ghost treehouses!
page_22: Black cats are considered good luck in Australia!
page_23: Halloween began as 'All Hallows' Eve'. That's over 1,000 years of ghosts!
page_24: The tallest hat ever worn was over 4 metres high!
page_25: Spider silk is stronger than steel of the same thickness!
page_26: Bats can eat 1,200 insects in one night. That's disco fuel!
page_27: Dingoes howl at the moon, but they hardly ever bark!
page_28: Kangaroo pouches face forward, perfect for carrying extra lollies!
page_29: Pumpkins are fruits. They grow from flowers!
page_30: Kookaburras are the world's biggest kingfishers, even witchy ones!
page_31: Dingoes arrived in Australia more than 4,000 years ago. That's mummy-old!
page_32: Fossils of giant prehistoric kangaroos have been found in caves!
page_33: Vampire bats really exist, but they only drink tiny sips!
page_34: Platypuses swim with their eyes shut. Their bills do the hunting!
page_35: Owls can't move their eyeballs, so they turn their whole heads!
page_36: Bats sleep hanging upside down, even on the moon!
page_37: Wombat teeth never stop growing. Chewing keeps them short!
page_38: A group of platypuses is called a paddle!
page_39: Even ghost bakers know: the biggest cupcake ever weighed as much as a fridge!
page_40: A witch's koala still needs 20 hours of sleep a day!
page_41: Wombats dig long tunnel homes called burrows!
page_42: A cauldron is a big cooking pot. Witches stir them in stories!
page_43: Echidna spikes are made of the same stuff as your fingernails!
page_44: Sugar gliders love sweet things. Nectar is nature's lolly!
page_45: A kangaroo can hop over 9 metres, faster than any ghost train!
page_46: Platypuses have no teeth as adults. They grind food with gravel!
page_47: Cockatoos can live over 70 years. That's older than your grandparents!
page_48: Australia grows blue-grey Jarrahdale pumpkins, perfect for wombat carvers!
page_49: A group of kangaroos is called a mob!
page_50: Happy Halloween from the Aussie Cuties!
